name: Puente de Alcántara

position.source: https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/660415643 (the river under the middle of the main arch, on the centre line of the deck; heading = the downstream face, 90° from the axis of the footway way 724145214, 81.0°)

rights.note: Roman bridge (founding of Toletum), rebuilt in the 10th century and under Alfonso X (13th century); the west gate-tower was rebuilt and decorated in 1484 under the Catholic Monarchs, and the east tower replaced by the Baroque triumphal arch in 1721. Builders unknown; all of it centuries old. Monumento nacional since 1921 (Bien de Interés Cultural).

notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q581532_puente_de_alcantara_toledo.py, tools/meshkit.py) with AI assistance. Modelled: the main semicircular arch (28.3 m) over the Tagus and the smaller one (16 m) over the slope up to the city, with granite voussoirs; the 7.8 m pier with its two trapezoidal buttresses crowned by refuges and stone balls; the long east abutment down the left bank with the horseshoe postern of the walled-up third arch; the two cantilevered refuges near the east end; parapets with coping, cornice band, end balls, two lamps; the west gate-tower (1484): passage arch, corner masses and recess on the city face with the sculpture niches and inscription, arms of the Catholic Monarchs and a box machicolation on the bridge face, brick courses, merlons, its base going down the slope; the Baroque east arch (1721): brick with granite quoins, arch with keystone and raised portcullis, pilasters with garlands, tablets, cornice, the attic with the imperial eagle, crown and shell crest, ball finials. Estimated (±): deck level (+21 m at the tower falling to +19 m at the east arch, ±1 m), arch springings (±1 m), tower and arch heights (±10 %), sculpture stylised. Axes: X along the bridge (+X east), +Z the downstream (south) face; y = 0 is the river (450.0 m, MDT05), origin on the water under the middle of the main arch. ground: keep with ground_fit false (a bridge): the banks are left as they are; piers to y = −3, abutments and tower base 2.5 m into the slope.
